purpose: Bridge for the single public index. The repository keeps modular backend data, but the homepage is the only public navigation doorway.

fallback_policy.json_failure: skip optional dataset and continue with canonical datasets
fallback_policy.country_failure: use the canonical country record in data/countries/
fallback_policy.empty_description: show record identity plus available relationships and evidence rather than a blank page

integrity_requirements: Every visible Atlas entry has a route into index.html or is explicitly external-only
Every relationship endpoint resolves or is explicitly marked unresolved
Unknown data is represented as missing/unknown, never as zero
Backend-only datasets remain discoverable through the index
Canonical IDs remain stable while aliases may expand
No stale standalone HTML reader is treated as a required navigation surface
design_rule: The index is the public Door. Data files remain modular for maintainability, but the reader should not have to know which historical subsystem owns a record.
